lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately six vertical columns and four horizontal rows across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal rows of white spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal ridge feature located on the upper lateral flank, defined by a distinct light-to-shadow pixel gradient transition along its ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10 to 12 discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the dorsal fin surface, with a higher spatial frequency observed at the basal region compared to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep V-shaped notch on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; dark artificial tag/sensor attached to the leading edge via a wire tether; horizontal linear scar at the posterior base of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple high-chroma yellow pixel clusters (Gnathanodon speciosus) localized near the branchial and ventral-anterior regions of the subject.
